_guia: Los libros. Cada bloque de 'items' es un libro y tiene su propia página. Para añadir uno, copiar un bloque entero y cambiarle los valores. 'categoria' agrupa los libros en las pestañas de arriba, y es uno de los géneros de la lista 'generos'. 'shape' es la forma de la portada, y hay tres, las mismas de todo el sitio: 'cuadrado', 'alto' (más alta que ancha, que es lo normal en un libro) o 'ancho' (más ancha que alta, como un infantil apaisado). Si se deja vacía o mal escrita, sale 'alto'. En la portada del sitio salen los tres primeros de esta lista.
title: Books
lead: In this section you can see all my literary works — novels, poetry collections and children's books. With just one click you will go straight to Amazon, where you can buy them with no trouble at all. THANK YOU FOR VISITING.
_guiaGeneros: Los géneros de los libros, en el orden de las pestañas. La 'categoria' de cada libro se elige de esta lista. Un género quitado de aquí deja de tener pestaña: los libros que todavía lo lleven salen igual, solo en 'Todos'.

items.title: New York casi devora a mis Abuelos
items.tagline: Two grandparents land in New York without speaking the language, and the city nearly devours them
items.synopsis:
A grandmother and grandfather leave the calm of their South American city and land in New York. The Big Apple greets them as a maze of skyscrapers, noise and customs they don't understand.

With nothing to guide them but their wits and their courage, and with the language against them, they set out to conquer the city amid the chaos of the subway and the misunderstandings of every day.

A novel about what it takes to start over far from home, told with humor.
items._nota: Si hay un fragmento del libro que quiera mostrar, va en 'excerpt'. Si se deja vacío, esa parte no sale.

items.title: Iván el Guía
items.tagline: A very fun tour guide who turns every trip into an adventure.
items.synopsis:
Iván is a fun, curious Spanish guide who, with his backpack always on, turns every trip into an adventure. He shows the way to tourists from all over the world.

On every journey, children learn a little history, culture and friendship, and discover the joy of traveling without needing a suitcase.

–Fourth book in the Cofre de Sueños (Box of Dreams) Collection.

items.title: Chánir y Mayaluca
items.tagline: Two very different creatures, alike in their feelings, share an unforgettable adventure.
items.synopsis:
Not every path is already laid out: some are built one step at a time. Chánir and Mayaluca set off on an unexpected journey through a city full of surprises.

They discover that sometimes you have to go far away to find what you are looking for, and that home can be where you least expect it.

A fable about courage and friendship.

items.title: Sueños y Fantasías
items.tagline: Children's poems where words turn into animals, butterflies and songs.
items.synopsis:
A journey in verse through the imagination of little ones. On every page, words become animals, stars and songs.

Dreams dress up as rainbows and wishes sail beyond the moon.

It is made to be read aloud, especially at bedtime.

items.title: En el Corazón del Bosque
items.tagline: A grumpy, stubborn little bear finds herself caught up in an incredible adventure.
items.synopsis:
Mama Bear and her two cubs wake from their long winter sleep and go for a walk among the trees and streams. The littlest bear wanders off from the group and ends up alone.

In the middle of the vast forest she will have to face her fears and learn that pride and stubbornness make you lose your way.
–Third book in the Cofre de Sueños (Box of Dreams) Collection.

items.title: Teresa & the two Puppies
items.tagline: A beautiful English edition of «Teresita y los dos Ositos».
items.synopsis:
The same story of Teresita, told in English for English readers: a woman who lives alone and finds companionship in two Bichon Frisé puppies.

Through play and laughter she discovers that true magic lies in the simplest bonds.

Part of the Box of Dreams Collection.

items.title: Bella
items.tagline: A white dove learns that being different is nothing she needs to hide.
items.synopsis:
Bella is teased for her unusual feathers, so she decides to hide who she is to avoid being rejected.

An unexpected contest puts her at the center of everyone's attention, and there she discovers that her strength was in exactly what makes her different.

–Second book in the Cofre de Sueños (Box of Dreams) Collection.

items.title: Teresita y los dos Ositos
items.tagline: A tender story that will fill you with joy.
items.synopsis:
Teresita lives a lonely, quiet life until two little Bichon Frisé puppies arrive, full of energy and affection.

With their games they change her days and teach her to see life with a new joy.

–First book in the Cofre de Sueños (Box of Dreams) Collection.

items.title: Jardín de Ilusiones
items.tagline: Poems of love and heartbreak, a perfect gift for the one you love.
items.synopsis:
An illustrated book of poems, written to be read slowly and dedicated to someone you love.

It speaks of the beauty of what passes and does not return, of love in its purest form, and of the hopes we keep without telling anyone.

items.title: Sueños de mi Niñez
items.tagline: Poems to read aloud, with a child beside you.
items.synopsis:
A children's book full of charming poems that invites young and old on a magical journey through the imagination.

It is the key to a world where anything is possible.

items.title: Secretos tras los Muros
items.tagline: Luciana grows up amid poverty and violence, and becomes strong in spite of everything.
items.synopsis:
Luciana is born into a poor, close-knit home marked by violence. Her character takes shape in that daily struggle.

She sets out on a search that takes her from religious life to romantic love, held up by her faith and her own superstitions.

Despite the humiliations and abuse she suffers, her body and mind grow stronger.

items.title: ¡Yo exterminé al último hombre!
items.tagline: A virus that kills only men, and a world left in the hands of a cruel woman.
items.synopsis:
Lorenzo and Nathalie invent something that could make life on Earth better, and greedy hands will do anything to take it.

At the same time, a strange virus that affects only men is spreading and threatens to wipe out humanity.

A survival adventure in a new world, ruled without mercy.

items.title: La reliquia: Invasión mortal
items.tagline: A family, an ancient relic, and a world no one had ever imagined.
items.synopsis:
Carolina, Prince and Ashley are caught up in an unprecedented adventure when the magic of an ancient relic drops them into a place they never imagined.

Guided by a one-of-a-kind character, they travel through beautiful and dangerous places, face extraordinary beings and search for a way back home. Terror and happiness arrive at the same time.

A thrilling, one-of-a-kind adventure, full of lessons and revelations.

items.title: El ojo de la muerte
items.tagline: A novel about revenge, and about what is left of our humanity when everything is against us.
items.synopsis:
Luis Mendoza grows up amid poverty and bullying, and witnesses his mother's murder. From then on, only one thing drives him: revenge.

The novel follows him through trials, adventures and the fight to survive, until true love enters his life and forces him to choose.

It is a harsh portrait of an unforgiving society, told without softening anything, and at the same time a story of resilience, growth and forgiveness.

upcoming._guia: Los libros que todavía no salen. Es un solo bloque, como el poema de la portada: un texto y una imagen al lado. En 'body' va todo el texto — una línea en blanco separa un párrafo del siguiente. Si se deja 'body' vacío, la sección entera desaparece.
upcoming.title: New York casi Devora a mis Abuelos
upcoming._nota: Cuando sepa cuál es el próximo libro, se nombra aquí. Mientras tanto queda este texto general; si se vacía 'body', la sección entera desaparece.
upcoming.body: In the Big Apple — not just a city, but an indecipherable maze of skyscrapers and strange noises — with nothing to guide them but their wits, their own courage and the language barrier, the grandparents set out to conquer the metropolis, amid the chaos of the subway, cultural misunderstandings and the struggle to survive in a world that never stops.
